# Davy Keith

- **Age:** 7  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome boy with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He has roguish, dancing hazel eyes, a positive snub nose, and a single dimple in one of his cheeks.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a mischievous, heedless, and forgetful child who possesses a lively curiosity and an energetic, overzealous nature. He frequently asks inquisitive questions and enjoys frightening people for fun. Aspiring to a future profession, Davy hopes to become a storekeeper.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +3 more_

## History

Davy Keith lost his father as a baby and had a sick mother, which left him without a proper upbringing in his early childhood. He arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside his twin sister [Dora](../character/dora.md), quickly establishing a reputation for unruly behavior by putting a toad in Marilla's bed and causing [Dora](../character/dora.md) to fall into a pigpen. Davy soon confesses his prank with the toad to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who secretly removes it with a shovel before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds it. His mischief continues when he locks [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse and lies about her whereabouts, but he tearfully repents after realizing his deceit hurts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). His antics extend to skipping his prayers to test [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and accidentally destroying lemon pies prepared for a guest. Despite his troublesome habits, such as sneaking plum jam, he displays occasional generosity, such as sharing jam bread with his sister before praying. Following the death of their uncle Richard, who leaves money in trust for the twins, Davy's stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) becomes permanent.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), +26 more_

## Quotes

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> "I never s’posed there was so many. I’m sorry it’s wrong to tell whop . . . falsehoods, ’cause it’s awful handy, but since it is I’m never going to tell any more. What are you going to do to me for telling them this time? I want to know."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P60](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0060)

> “But I tell you there is,” persisted Davy. “It was in that question Marilla taught me last Sunday. ‘Why should we love God?’ It says, ‘Because He makes preserves, and redeems us.’ Preserves is just a holy way of saying jam.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P27](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0027)

> "if Marilla’ll hold them by the legs, ’cause I guess it’d take both my hands to manage the axe. It’s awful jolly fun to see them hopping about after their heads are cut off."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P21](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0021)

> "If I’m as good as good can be all day tomorrow will you let me be just as bad as I like all the next day?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P36](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serves as Davy's teacher and mentor, holding a bond of fond affection with him. Davy frequently confides his misdeeds and silly ideas to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), such as confessing when he hid a toad in Marilla's bed or when he skipped his prayers. Though his unruly pranks—like locking [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse—cause trouble, Davy tearfully repents when he realizes his deceit hurts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and she patiently lectures and forgives him while maintaining her fondness for him.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +15 more_

- Friend of — fond affection for her  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P36](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0036), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)</sub>
- Student of  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister who lives alongside him at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy frequently targets [Dora](../character/dora.md) with his mischievous antics, such as pushing her into a pigpen or hiding her in a toolhouse and lying that she was missing. Despite his troublesome behavior toward her, they remain household companions and spend their days together around the farm.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +15 more_

- Sibling of — brother  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +7 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) serves as Davy's guardian, enforcing discipline and giving orders while managing his unruly nature. Davy constantly tests Marilla's boundaries through pranks like putting a toad in her bed, testing her warnings about prayer, or hiding [Dora](../character/dora.md). Although [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) must punish him for his deceitful pranks, she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a secret amusement over his antics and maintain a deep affection for him.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +10 more_

- Serves under — guardian who gives orders and enforces discipline  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028)</sub>
